system.description:
Mark a HP to deploy a Redline Ward
around yourself at Very Close range.
This might look like a haze of coolant
vapor, warning lights, pressure
distortion, combat drug mist, hostile
sensor static, or unstable cyberware
output bleeding into the air around you
While in the ward, you have resistance
to your choice of physical or techno
damage. Choose when you activate this
protocol. Allies also gain this benefit
while in the ward.
The ward disappears if you move out of
it, mark 2 or more HP, or use this
protocol again.
